Title: Authenticate and log out
Source evidence: T: Table 3.4 FR-01; I: Table 13 (individual login, 14/14); Q: D23 username and password 11/15
Acceptance criterion: Valid credentials create a session; invalid credentials give one generic message; logout destroys the session server-side and is audit-logged.

Title: Change and reset password
Source evidence: T: Table 3.4 FR-02; Q: D23 admin password reset 11/15
Acceptance criterion: Passwords stored with password_hash; admin reset forces change at next login; old password required to change own password; no password appears in logs.

Title: Role-based function restriction
Source evidence: T: Table 3.4 FR-03, Table 3.9; I: Table 10; Q: D19, D23 role-limited access 13/15
Acceptance criterion: Each endpoint has a declared permission; deny by default; a forbidden call returns 403 and is audit-logged; tests cover every role against the permission matrix.

Title: Assigned-project restriction
Source evidence: T: Table 3.4 FR-04 (amended per MP s4.6); I: Table 10 Director 'all projects'
Acceptance criterion: Every request carrying a project, activity or record ID is checked against assignments; an unassigned ID returns 403 (IDOR blocked) and is audit-logged.

Title: User administration
Source evidence: T: Table 3.4 FR-05; I: Table 10 Administrator
Acceptance criterion: Admin can create, edit, activate, deactivate; deactivated users lose active sessions; first admin created by a one-time setup command; role changes audit-logged.

Title: Project management
Source evidence: T: Table 3.4 FR-06; DR: Table 6 project name, location, contract sum
Acceptance criterion: PM who creates a project is auto-assigned; planned finish not before planned start; contract sum DECIMAL >= 0; archive instead of delete; any project type supported.

Title: Assign users to projects
Source evidence: T: Table 3.4 FR-07; I: Table 10 PM user assignment
Acceptance criterion: Unique (project, user) pair enforced by constraint; assignment changes audit-logged; removal takes effect on the next request.

Title: Activities
Source evidence: T: Table 3.4 FR-08; DR: Table 6 activities (15 docs), budgeted cost per activity (9); Q: B3
Acceptance criterion: Date order validated; budgeted cost DECIMAL >= 0 or empty (then duration weighting applies); archive instead of delete.

Title: Record progress
Source evidence: T: Table 3.4 FR-09; Q: B1 (3.33); I: Theme 1 manual relay
Acceptance criterion: One-screen entry per activity; date pre-filled to today (Africa/Accra); 0 to 100 enforced; entry saved as Submitted.

Title: Project completion %
Source evidence: T: s2.2.7, Table 3.10; I: PM-01 weighted completion; DR: F1 completion % (16 docs); Q: D18 13/15
Acceptance criterion: Matches the Table 2.1 worked example (35%); uses approved progress only; BAC = 0 shows 'not available'.

Title: Planned versus earned value
Source evidence: T: Table 3.4 FR-11; I: Table 6 (14/14); Q: B2 (3.13), C3; DR: E7 Weak 64%
Acceptance criterion: PV uses the linear planned % rule; chart plots cumulative PV and EV by reporting period; matches hand-calculated example (PV 98,000; EV 70,000).

Title: Schedule status and delayed activities
Source evidence: T: Table 3.4 FR-12; Q: C4, B12 (2.47 lowest); DR: E8 Weak 36/36; I: Table 6 delayed list 7/14
Acceptance criterion: Status shown with colour, text and icon; each of the six states covered by a unit test; delayed list sortable by days late.

Title: Milestones
Source evidence: T: Table 3.4 FR-13; Q: B4, C5; I: Table 6 (8/14), clients' milestone timeline
Acceptance criterion: Due and achieved dates stored; optional link to an activity; overdue state computed; client timeline shows milestones only.

Title: Approved budget and revisions
Source evidence: T: Table 3.4 FR-14; DR: Table 6 budget (2 sources); I: C5 budget revisions acted on before QS told
Acceptance criterion: Exactly one current approved version per project (constraint plus transaction); history retained; amounts DECIMAL(15,2).

Title: Expenditure
Source evidence: T: Table 3.4 FR-15; Q: B5; DR: expenditure single source (DT-10)
Acceptance criterion: Amount > 0, date not in the future, category from list; single-source field validation (confirmation step); hidden from SE and Client in API responses.

Title: Budget versus expenditure, CV, CPI
Source evidence: T: Table 3.4 FR-16; Q: C6, B6; I: C4 manual CPI errors; DR: F1 CV/CPI in 19 docs, E9 Weak 67%
Acceptance criterion: CV = EV - AC; CPI not shown when AC = 0; budget consumed = AC / current approved budget; total budget never used as EV or AC.

Title: SV and SPI
Source evidence: T: Table 3.4 FR-17; DR: F1 SV/SPI in 12 docs; I: role needs (Director, PM)
Acceptance criterion: SV = EV - PV; SPI not shown when PV = 0; matches worked example (SV -28,000; SPI 0.71).

Title: Labour and materials
Source evidence: T: Table 3.4 FR-18; Q: B7, B8, C7; I: Table 5 material stock hardest to obtain (6)
Acceptance criterion: Standard units from a list; balance = received - used; labour details hidden from Client; rates hidden from SE.

Title: Equipment status
Source evidence: T: Table 3.4 FR-19; E10 equipment part follows D11 (master prompt s4.10); I: Table 8 equipment fault (3)
Automated or recorded evidence: Rule A14 exists and is unit-tested; no data-entry screen
Acceptance criterion: Status list (working, faulty, idle, off site); faulty raises A14 once; no fleet management.

Title: In-app alerts
Source evidence: T: Table 3.4 FR-20, Table 3.11; I: Table 8; DR: F3 alerts top need (16 docs), E8 Weak 100%
Automated or recorded evidence: AlertRulesTest (A1 to A15, A6b); WorkflowTest stoppage test
Acceptance criterion: An alert is created when its condition first becomes true and not again until cleared; evaluated on save and on the first dashboard request each day; recipients follow the table; clients receive A4 notice only.

Title: Two-level alert thresholds
Source evidence: T: Table 3.4 FR-21 (amended); I: s5.1 threshold ownership (9 internal)
Acceptance criterion: A project threshold outside the global limit is rejected; QS proposals need Director approval; every change audit-logged.

Title: SMS for critical and high alerts
Source evidence: T: Table 3.4 FR-22; I: Table 9, DIR-01 rule; QS-01 monthly cap; PM-02 overload
Automated or recorded evidence: AdminBackupTest::testSmsDailyAndMonthlyCaps; no message sent to a real phone
Acceptance criterion: One SMS per alert; capped messages logged as 'capped'; credentials only from environment; sandbox adapter used in tests; no claim of delivery until a real provider is tested.

Title: Consolidated overview
Source evidence: T: Table 3.4 FR-23; Q: D18, D20; I: Table 11; Q: C11 top challenge (3.67)
Acceptance criterion: Overview shows KPI cards, PV/EV line chart, budget vs expenditure bar chart, delayed table, milestones, open alerts, last updated; status uses colour plus text and icon.

Title: Refresh and last-updated stamp
Source evidence: T: Table 3.4 FR-24, s1.11; I: Table 6 last updated 14/14; Q: E22 8/15 'immediately'
Acceptance criterion: Light 'changed-since' endpoint; full data only when changed; pauses when tab hidden; last successful refresh shown separately; backoff on failure; 'waking server' state.

Title: Audit trail
Source evidence: T: Table 3.4 FR-25; Q: D23 activity log 11/15; I: Table 13 (8)
Acceptance criterion: Actor, action, entity, ID, old and new values, IP, user agent, timestamp; no update or delete path; DB user lacks UPDATE/DELETE on audit_logs; no secrets stored.

Title: Export reports (corrected wording)
Source evidence: T: Table 3.4 FR-26 (garbled, corrected); I: s5.3 reports list
Acceptance criterion: Same queries and permissions as dashboards; CSV cells starting with = + - @ are neutralised; exports streamed, not stored; export audit-logged.

Title: Client read-only summary
Source evidence: T: Table 3.4 FR-27; I: s4.2 clients (5/5); Q: D22 hidden fields
Acceptance criterion: API response contains no expenditure lines, labour details, budget revisions, internal alerts, supplier prices or other clients' data (verified by field-level test).

Title: Valuations and payment certificates
Source evidence: T: Table 3.8 FR-23 (missing from Table 3.4), Table 3.11 A9; I: Table 4 QS incidents; DR: DT-09
Acceptance criterion: Certification and payment kept separate; outstanding = certified - sum(paid); unique certificate number per project; overdue after submission + payment period.

Title: Unified login and role-based redirect
Acceptance criterion: No role field in the form, URL or cookie; logged-in user opening /login goes to own dashboard; session ID regenerated; lockout after repeated failures; idle timeout; CSRF token.

Title: PM approval of progress
Source evidence: I: s5.2 (DIR-01, PM-01, PM-02), Table 14 confirmation (SE-01, SE-04); DR: feedback missing 56%
Acceptance criterion: States submitted, approved, returned; resubmission allowed; A13 raised for pending entries; approval audit-logged with approver and time.

Title: Director approval of budget revisions
Source evidence: I: s5.2 (QS-01, QS-02, DIR-01); I: Table 9 unapproved revision SMS
Acceptance criterion: Approval supersedes the previous current version in one transaction; A12 raised while pending; separation of duties: requester cannot approve.

Title: Delay-reason dropdown
Source evidence: I: Table 14 (SE-03, SE-04); I: Table 9 stoppage/safety (DIR-01, PM-02, SE-02, SE-04)
Acceptance criterion: Reasons from a maintained lookup table; stoppage or safety selection raises A15 once per record; not a safety module.

Title: Material requests and store balance
Source evidence: I: Table 14 (PM-01, PM-02, SE-01 to SE-04); I: Table 5
Acceptance criterion: Request status visible to requester; balance never negative without warning; supplier prices hidden from SE and Client.

Title: Material reorder alert
Source evidence: T: Table 3.7 Could Have; I: Table 8 material low (4)
Automated or recorded evidence: Rule A10 exists and is unit-tested; no data-entry screen
Acceptance criterion: Raised once when balance first drops below reorder level; cleared when restocked.

Title: Director cross-project view
Source evidence: I: s4.2 Director; MP: s4.6
Tables: projects, activities, progress_records, budgets, expenditures, notifications
Acceptance criterion: Shows every non-archived project; read-only; same KPI service as project view.

Title: Backup and restore function
Source evidence: T: s3.17.5, NFR-06; I: Table 13 daily backups 14/14; Q: D23 daily backup 7/15
Acceptance criterion: Backup file decrypts and restores into a separate database with matching record counts and KPI values (FT-32); backup and restore audit-logged.

Title: Form resilience and draft autosave
Automated or recorded evidence: Browser offline test; drafts in lib/drafts.js (no automated unit test)
Acceptance criterion: Failed submit keeps values and shows 'not saved'; draft restored after reload; draft cleared after successful save.

Title: Offline operation with synchronisation
Source evidence: MP: s8.17 and s0 mission; Q: F2 (4.40, 12/15); I: SE-01, SE-04, SE-02; DR: s11 item 8
Acceptance criterion: Each queued entry has a client UUID (idempotent replay); server re-checks role, assignment and validation; conflicts shown to the user; offline views marked 'offline, last synced at'; logout clears local data.

Title: Progress photo
Source evidence: DR: s11 item 8, DT-03 WhatsApp photos hard to search; MP s4.13
Acceptance criterion: Only JPEG/PNG/WebP accepted after server-side check; never stored on web server disk; hidden from Client unless approved (default hidden).

Title: Days remaining to planned completion
Source evidence: Q: D21 'Time remaining to projected contract end date'
Automated or recorded evidence: KPI card "Days to planned finish"; KpiResult::daysToPlannedFinish
Acceptance criterion: Shows planned finish minus today in days; negative shown as 'x days past planned completion'; no forecast.

Title: Dark and light theme
Source evidence: MP: s0 mission (owner directive)
Automated or recorded evidence: Browser smoke and axe scan in light and dark
Acceptance criterion: Toggle on every page; both themes meet WCAG AA contrast for text and status badges.

Title: Security
Source evidence: T: Table 3.5 NFR-01; Q: D17 data security 10/15, D23; I: Table 13
Automated or recorded evidence: AuthSecurityTest; SecurityProbeTest; CSRF and header tests; OWASP table in TEST_REPORT s5
Acceptance criterion: ST-01 to ST-16 pass; no stack traces in production; headers verified.

Title: Performance (completed)
Source evidence: T: Table 3.5 NFR-02 (incomplete '2s'); MP s4.9 targets
Automated or recorded evidence: ApacheBench p95 130 to 245 ms at 20 users; page 2.1 s on throttled mobile (TEST_REPORT s7). Not yet on the live host
Acceptance criterion: PT-01, PT-02 and PT-05 meet targets; results reported honestly with tool and settings.

Title: Low bandwidth
Source evidence: T: Table 3.5 NFR-03; Q: D17 data cost 7/15, connectivity 11/15; I: low data use (4)
Automated or recorded evidence: Lazy Chart.js, cached assets, summary polling (TEST_REPORT s7)
Acceptance criterion: Unchanged poll response under 1 KB; gzip on; static assets cached.

Title: Responsive, mobile-first
Source evidence: T: Table 3.5 NFR-04; Q: D16 smartphone 9/15; I: mobile layout (12)
Automated or recorded evidence: Browser smoke at 360 px, 44 views, no horizontal scroll
Acceptance criterion: No horizontal scroll at 360 px; touch targets >= 44 px; main tasks completed on a phone.

Title: Usability
Source evidence: T: Table 3.5 NFR-05; I: simplicity (11), Director quote; Q: D17 training 9/15
Automated or recorded evidence: axe-core WCAG 2.1 AA 0 violations; usability sessions T1 to T5 pending (owner)
Acceptance criterion: Evaluation tasks T1 to T11 completable; SUS collected (indicative); status never by colour alone.

Title: Backup and recovery (completed)
Source evidence: T: Table 3.5 NFR-06 (RTO missing); I: Table 13 recovery within hours, 1 day loss (DIR-01, QS-01, QS-02)
Automated or recorded evidence: Encrypted backup, restore verify with checksums; live drill pending
Acceptance criterion: Timed restore test meets RTO; backup age never above 24 h in operation log.

Title: Data integrity
Source evidence: T: Table 3.5 NFR-07; Q: C9 manual errors (3.00); DR: E3 consistency Weak 67%, single-source fields
Automated or recorded evidence: Validation and constraint tests; SupportTest; schema CHECK constraints (27)
Acceptance criterion: Invalid input rejected with field messages by server; constraint tests pass.

Title: Data-entry efficiency
Source evidence: T: Table 3.5 NFR-08; Q: D17 entry time 6/15; I: short forms (9)
Automated or recorded evidence: One-screen progress form with defaults (browser smoke)
Acceptance criterion: Progress update in one screen with at most 4 inputs; date defaults to today.

Title: Availability
Source evidence: T: Table 3.5 NFR-09; Q: D17 power 4/15; I: off-site hosting (4)
Automated or recorded evidence: Off-site host prepared; cold start about 1 min on the free plan
Acceptance criterion: Failure message on every failed request; 'waking up the server' state; /health endpoint.

Title: Configurability
Source evidence: T: Table 3.5 NFR-10; I: two-level thresholds
Automated or recorded evidence: Settings and thresholds editable in the app (AdminBackupTest, WorkflowTest)
Acceptance criterion: Changing a parameter changes behaviour without a deploy.

Title: Host-agnostic, stateless deployment
Source evidence: MP: s5
Automated or recorded evidence: Same code on XAMPP, Apache container layout, MySQL 8 over TLS; CI container smoke job
Acceptance criterion: Same commit runs on XAMPP and in Docker; container restart keeps sessions.

Title: Local conventions
Source evidence: MP: s0.1 item 8; DR: E3 consistency Weak 67% (units and date formats)
Automated or recorded evidence: SupportTest (phone, money, dates); alert texts DD/MM/YYYY
Acceptance criterion: No FLOAT columns; formatting helpers unit-tested.

Title: Data protection
Source evidence: MP: s4.15, s10; T: s3.21 ethics (referenced)
Automated or recorded evidence: Synthetic seed only; history scanned; Act 843 note in DEPLOYMENT_OPTIONS
Acceptance criterion: Demo seed labelled and removable; no real names or numbers.
